segments.text: This season finale is built around one thing Claire wants more than anything: a perfect family portrait. She has everyone wearing white, she has a photographer booked for one hour, and she wants the whole family standing together on the staircase looking normal for once.

segments.text: Naturally, the day starts falling apart almost immediately. There’s a broken step in the background, and Claire decides to fix it herself. She only makes it worse. Haley gets a pimple and starts acting like the portrait is now impossible.

segments.text: Meanwhile, Phil takes Alex to a Lakers game with Gloria and Manny. Claire calls while Phil is having fun and he ignores the phone. Then the kiss cam lands on Phil and Gloria.

segments.text: They try not to kiss, but the whole arena starts booing, so Gloria gives Phil a quick kiss just to make the camera move on.

segments.text: Claire never actually sees the kiss. Phil thinks she did, though, so he spends the rest of the day acting guilty and trying to explain something she isn’t even asking about. Claire is mainly angry because he ignored her call when she was trying to deal with the portrait disaster.

segments.text: Jay finally tells her the obvious: life is not perfect. Claire snaps back that if he has some quick fix for her personality, he should go ahead and give it to her. Jay responds by throwing mud at her.

segments.text: That starts a full mud fight. Within seconds, the clean white outfits Claire obsessed over are ruined. At first she is horrified. Then she gives up and joins in.

segments.text: That’s when they finally take the picture—covered in mud, laughing, and not pretending anymore. It’s nothing like the portrait Claire planned, but it ends up looking much more like the family she actually has.
